title: Help at seat {{seat}}
intro: Something not working at your seat? Tap what is wrong and the network team will come to you. We don't need your name.

done.thanks: Thanks, we know. Someone from the team will come to seat {{seat}}.
done.again: We already have this one for seat {{seat}} and noted that you asked again.
done.ok: Thanks, we told the team it works again at seat {{seat}}.

invalid: This help link is not valid. Please use the QR code on your seat, or ask at the info desk.
busy: Too many reports from here. Please wait a few minutes or ask at the info desk.

report.open: Your report is in. Nobody from the team has taken it yet; someone will come.
report.sent: Your report was sent to a tech nearby. They will be on their way shortly.
report.taken: Someone from the team has your report and is on the way.
report.fixed: Your report was marked fixed. Still not working? Tap it again below.
report.ok: You told us it works again. Thanks! Broken again? Tap it below.

ahead_one: One report is ahead of yours.
outage_one: We know: the network at your seat has been down for {{count}} min. The team is on it, no need to report it. Something else? Tap it below.
outage_other: We know: the network at your seat has been down for {{count}} min. The team is on it, no need to report it. Something else? Tap it below.
statusLink: Updates on the network status page
backUp_one: The network at your seat has been back for {{count}} min. Does it work again? Then tap “It works again” below.
backUp_other: The network at your seat has been back for {{count}} min. Does it work again? Then tap “It works again” below.
worksHint: Fixed itself? Tell the team so nobody walks over for nothing.

speed.title: Test your connection
speed.intro: Measures the connection from your seat to our server in the hall, not the internet. It takes about 20 seconds: pause other downloads first.
speed.saved: Saved for seat {{seat}}. The team sees it with your report.
